question: Do unchanged previously tested rules produce repeatedly positive compound account growth across separated calendar periods and additional DEX assets?
design: A finite robustness/replication study, not an optimizer or an instruction to test until a positive p-value. Existing strategies and all prior outputs remain immutable. Reuse backtesting.py0.6.6 via experiments/upstream_benchmark/benchmark.py. No live executor or daemon.

markets.limit: Retain provider token label and contract; token migrations/issuer/bridge risk not assumed resolved

market_selection_limit: Named liquid-asset candidates chosen from provider identity/fee pages, not from this experiment's return. Current surviving pool selection is not survivorship-free. No whole-market population or complete legal/contract eligibility claim.

data.missing_policy: Only provider-returned native4h bars; no invented hours or filling. Require complete128-bar warmup and evaluation grid. Native4h aggregation is not equivalent to pretending unobserved hourly fills occurred.

shared_controls.source_of_controls: Reuse unchanged FixedSignals:20%equity order target,25cap,10reserve,5minimum,one long position,3%daily/10%drawdown/5%position observed-bar exits; no leverage/top-ups. No native guaranteed on-chain stop.

cost_limit: Market-specific reported fee floor rather than charging0.05%to every pool. Extra cost and fixed amounts remain uncalibrated sensitivities, not actual historical gas; currently published fees are not an authenticated historical fee schedule.
execution: For each candidate/window, form signals only from that contiguous warmup+window data; reuse unchanged indicator definitions and next-bar execution. Known scheduled boundary liquidation remains. Cash and20%-initial buy-and-hold use matching costs. Save all failed/skipped outcomes. No mid-run or post-result parameter tuning.

repeatability_screen.meaning: A research screening flag, not a probability, independent certification or authorization to fund. Missing required evidence makes INSUFFICIENT, never a pass.

continuous_compounding: The18/24-month study carries the SAME100 account, positions, cash, equity, stops and order sizing through the whole interval, without resets at quarters. Quarterly returns derived from this continuous marked-equity ledger are reported separately. Products of independently reset100-dollar quarter tests are NOT a funded account path.
statistics: Show sign counts, worst quarter, cumulative continuous return, daily geometric return, drawdown, trades, cash/hold comparison and all outcomes. No p-values or future-profit probability from correlated runs. Existing global seen-data restrictions remain. New assets provide transfer tests, not a fresh independent proof after selection.
tests: Test non-overlap, no missing-quarter passes, strict count/cost pairing, correct continuous interval accounting, synthetic all-pass and adversarial failures, plus original16engine tests. No source change before red tests.
publication: Additive research module, small per-run CSV, derived summaries, provenance, paired FA/EN findings, work/status checkpoint, isolated branch and draft PR; no force-push or merge.
fa: این دور پنج بازار و بازه‌های غیرهم‌پوشان را با همان قواعد قبلی بررسی می‌کند. برای تکرارپذیری فقط سود یک سال کافی نیست؛ دوره منفی، هزینه بالاتر، حساب پیوسته و آزمون دیرتر هم گزارش می‌شوند. آزمون با سرمایه واقعی یا وعده رسیدن حتمی به سود مجاز نیست.
